data.title: 矢来美羽 · 厨房里的早饭
data.description: 早上起得有些晚，她靠在厨房台边喝水，面包还放在盘子里等着。
data.action: standing by the counter with a glass of water
data.promptProse: In a sunny, minimalist coastal kitchen, Miu stands by a clean marble breakfast bar, holding a tall glass of sparkling water beside a plate of freshly toasted golden bread. Gentle morning sunlight pours through sheer curtains, illuminating steam from a kettle, potted herbs, and her tiny, endearing vampire fangs peeking out as she yawns softly.
